named_subject: cow (head and front of body, close up)
action: The cow's head starts tilted to the right in frame 1, straightens to face the viewer in frame 2, then the camera settles closer and the head holds nearly still from frame 3 to frame 8.
identity_gap: The muzzle, dash eyes, small smile, spots and swirl spot match the doodle, but from frame 3 on the round left ear and the hooked right ear are drawn as loose separate dashes that read as horns or antennae. The framing crops the body and legs, so only the head and the front of the body show.
notes: The film shows the cow opening its mouth to moo in frames 3 to 8, but the drawn mouth stays as the same closed smile, and there is a jump in scale and position between frames 2 and 3. The change that would help most is to open the muzzle's mouth line in time with the film in frames 3 to 8, while keeping the ears as the closed loop shapes from the doodle.
